facts.fact: The OGP IRM results report says a legal framework for promoting public open data was still being drafted as a decree by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform and the Digital Development Agency, at the end of the 2021-2023 plan.

The IRM report says the Digital Development Agency, lead for the open data commitment, redesigned and runs the national open data portal data.gov.ma, launched in 2011 and redesigned from December 2021.
The IRM report says by end 2023 the portal held over 500 datasets and 37 institutions were updating datasets on it, according to the Digital Development Agency.
